notes.title: Patch - 0.1.2
notes.content:
[h3]Forsaken Valley Penitentiary[/h3]
[previewyoutube=Gg90mDQVucw;rightthumb]
[/previewyoutube]
	The concept of this map is a haunted prison. It may be harder to explore compared to the other maps because most of the areas are blocked, but the design is intended to help you explore with ease. You’ll have to pay attention to the key items to explore the whole area.

[list]
[*] In the Penitentiary there is a keypad door that you’ll have to find the passcode to explore.
[*] Block cells and the cafeteria are locked with a key. You’ll have to find 3 keys to explore the whole map.
[*] The entrance part of the map has some wood planks, so you’ll have to use the axe to find your resources.
[/list]


[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] The player and ghost speed have been adjusted
[/list]

[h3]Visual[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Post processing effects have changed to have a brighter visual and easier to see
[*] Changed the UV light color
[/list]

notes.title: Patch note - 0.1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45006205/e18ff84a67c7a0ecbd8989fba68b188aececeedb.jpg[/img][h2]Tutorial[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added rooms to better explain how the ghost wanders the scene
[/list]
 
[h2]Ghosts[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added “soft” events to reduce the amount of jumpscares and have a better build-up on the tension.
[*] There are 5 new events.
[*] Change the algorithm to avoid event repetition.
[*] Made it easier to differentiate the way the ghost wanders in the scene.
[*] Reduced the amount of behaviors to make it easier to determine what the ghost hates
[*] Reduced the amount of ghost to have an easier way to tell the ghosts apart
[*] Added new ghost models for more visual variety in the game.
[*] Changes to the sound effects to better match the new ghost models
[/list]

[h2] Visuals[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Change the fade-in effect to have a more design-accurate visual
[*] Removed the in-game camera glitch to have a more clear visual
[/olist]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Wood Plank synchronization
[*] No reward bug
[*] Loud Volume
[*] Ghost Name on Stats screen
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Update Available!
notes.content:
This week on the development, I decided to add to the demo some of the features that were only available on the alpha version of the game.

Features added:

[list]
[*] Store and new items:
Now you earn money at the end of each play and can use this money to buy new Itens that help you analyze the ghost.
[*] Dificulty progression:
You can spend your earned money to play a more difficult mode and earn even more money on each play.
[*] Axe Durabillity:
The axe is not indestructible anymore. Use it with care to explore, and keep on searching for axes to be able to explore the whole area.
[*] Gameplay Change: 
Now you don't spawn with any items (only the ones you bought at the store). You have to search for every item.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=rSlp5kYjF_I;full][/previewyoutube]
